items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: I got my inspiration from ... Baby Dodds. ... I used to go to dances. I, wherever Baby Dodds was playing I was always there. And actually I got a lot from, learned a lot from him.

ctx.x: And, well, he got his inspiration from Bunk. And I got my inspiration from Henry Martin, Black Benny, Red Happy, Baby Dodds. But Baby Dodds used to play in the Orleans during them times. Yeah. Well, after I got old enough I used to go to dances. I, wherever Baby Dodds was playing I was always there. And actually I got a lot from, learned a lot from him. Oh, sure. Yeah. Well, when I, around 1918, I was taking press roll lessons from Henry Martin. Yeah. He was a left-hander like me.

items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1960-03-16
items.q: Well I can't say it was any too close to Baby Dodds, but he was really a good jazz drummer in his days.

ctx.x: What style? Was it something like Baby Dodds or anything particular about his style you could tell us?
Well I can't say it was any too close to Baby Dodds, but he was really a good jazz drummer in his days.
What kind of a drum set, can you remember what kind of a set he had? See he's not around naturally to tell us what-
